how: F10's rooms in form A, Border terms and the announced plan, do the work around a deal: members discuss a border inside the room before contact (r/drawhelix), check a request's consensus and credibility (r/switzerland), and carry the terms to placers and templates, a step members say is still incomplete (r/poland, r/transformers).

F26's rooms in form A keep a settled border only where placers learn and accept its terms: plans were missed and placing stopped once the agreement was found (r/placetardis), some members honour a treaty against their preference while others place against it (r/furry), and repudiation sits beside truce complaints (r/thailand).

F28's rooms in form A make help wait on conditions: the helper's home work must be safe (r/ripcity, r/utaustin), the neighbour must stop attacking (r/catalunya), and promised help stays apart from help delivered (r/lsu, r/necrodancer); form A as a whole leaves P16 untouched, and F28's rooms are 10 of its 22 add-condition holders.

F31's rooms in form A show hosting only as a request and a one-off permission: an overlap permitted for one arrangement (r/foxes), a replacement permission called provisional (r/malaysia), an incorporation offered and accepted on conditions (r/mindcrack); no standing host rule is shown, and F31's rooms are 8 of the form's 12 restrict holders at an element the form as a whole leaves untouched.

F22's rooms in form D, Keeping, with help or carrying on, give help when their own work is secure and they have pixels to spare (r/mylittlepony, r/OnePiece), and they weigh what the help does to a third room's mark (r/gamindustri).

Two of F22's three rooms that restrict A13 in form D give help from surplus, not shortage: aid repays earlier protection once the room's own image is finished (r/OnePiece), and donors weigh their own work's safety (r/mylittlepony); r/gamindustri reports aid without a shortage first.

F08's rooms in form B, Behind the thread: chat, scripts, raids, keep a truce only where it reaches the placers, and for script runners the target: an accommodation needs compatible script targets (r/india, r/AmericanFlaginPlace), and a declared truce holds among the placers who learn it (r/neu, r/minnesotavikings).
